prompt:
Mobile app screen, portrait, shot straight on, filling the frame edge to edge — no phone mockup, no hand, no desk, no shadow. This is the UI itself.

The interface is designed as a clinical physiotherapy assessment sheet printed by offset lithography. Cool paper-white ground (#F2F3F1) with faint printed rules, near-black ink (#14161A), one process blue (#1B4FD8) used as a saturated FIELD that owns whole regions rather than as a small accent, and a signal red (#C8102E) reserved exclusively for the safety state.

Structure, top to bottom:
- A narrow printed header band with a form code at far left in small condensed uppercase letterspaced type, "RITMO" set as a form title, and a stamped-looking language chip "ES" at the right.
- A ruled context strip: "SEMANA 7 / 16" and "FASE: CONSTRUCCIÓN" in small caps labels above their values, then "MARATÓN CDMX · FALTAN 63 DÍAS", all sitting on printed rule lines like filled-in form fields.
- The dominant element: a large solid process-blue field occupying roughly the middle third, reversed out in paper-white. Inside it, a small label "HOY · TIRADA LARGA", then an enormous tabular figure "18" with a small "km" unit tucked beside its baseline, then on a second line "6:15–6:40 /km" and "ZONA 2 · ~1 H 55 MIN" in monospaced figures. A thin white rule under the figure like a form's answer line.
- Below it, a footnote in the form's own voice, small serif-free italic-free text: "POR QUÉ ESTA SESIÓN — Construye la base aeróbica. Va lento a propósito."
- A live transcript area rendered as two ruled entry lines with tiny "TÚ" and "COACH" labels in the margin, handwriting-free, set in the same grotesque.
- At the bottom band, the single non-printed element: a disc of wet process-blue ink with soft concentric ripples radiating from it, visibly alive and slightly irregular against the crisp printed page, with the caption "ESCUCHANDO…" in small letterspaced uppercase directly beneath it.

Typography: a condensed grotesque for labels set in uppercase with generous letterspacing, a normal-width grotesque for values, tabular lining figures throughout. No serifs, no rounded corners anywhere, no drop shadows, no gradients except the ink ripple. Hairline printed rules, tick boxes, and a faint registration cross in one corner. Print texture: subtle offset ink grain and very slight misregistration on one element.

Spanish language UI. Clean, authoritative, calm. Not a fitness app, not a wellness app, not dark mode.
